1	# Project Phoenix - Development Notes
     2	
     3	## Timeline
     4	
     5	- **Alpha Release**: March 15, 2024
     6	- **Beta Release**: June 1, 2024
     7	- **Production Launch**: September 30, 2024
     8	
     9	## Team
    10	
    11	- Lead Developer: Sarah Chen
    12	- Backend: Marcus Rodriguez, Aisha Patel
    13	- Frontend: James Kim, Elena Volkov
    14	- QA: David Thompson
    15	
    16	## Key Features
    17	
    18	1. Real-time collaboration
    19	2. Advanced analytics dashboard
    20	3. Mobile app integration
    21	4. API v2 with GraphQL support
    22	
    23	## Current Status
    24	
    25	We're currently in the alpha testing phase with 50 internal users. Feedback has been positive, particularly regarding the new UI. The beta release is scheduled for June 1, 2024, and we're on track to meet this deadline.
    26	
    27	## Technical Stack
    28	
    29	- Frontend: React 18, TypeScript
    30	- Backend: Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL
    31	- Infrastructure: AWS (ECS, RDS, S3)
    32	- CI/CD: GitHub Actions
    33	
    34	## Blockers
    35	
    36	- Need to finalize API documentation before beta
    37	- Mobile app needs performance optimization
    38	- Waiting on security audit completion
